clue.text: Female establishment covering large part of New York

indicators.note: the establishment is wrapped around the size letter, covering it

parts.note: a harem is the women's quarters of a household
L is the standard abbreviation for large, as on clothing labels

explanation.surface: A women's institution seems to occupy a big chunk of Manhattan.
explanation.definitionFit: Harlem is a neighbourhood in northern Manhattan, so it is literally a district of the city.

clue.text: Not a major route over wide area

definitions.meaning: split as '...', a British secondary road rather than a main A-road or motorway
widely spread out, as rumours are spread far and wide

explanation.surface: Directions for a minor road that nonetheless covers a broad region.
explanation.walkthrough: In Britain, B-roads are minor roads, below A-roads; read the answer as 'a B-road' for the first sense.
explanation.definitionFit: The adverb can mean widely or at large, as in news spreading over a broad region.

clue.text: Below border, this fog spoiled uninterrupted view

indicators.note: in a down entry the rearranged letters sit below the border word

parts.note: a line is a boundary or border

indicators.note: spoiled signals the words this fog are broken up and rearranged

explanation.surface: Mist beneath a boundary ruined a clear outlook.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Below' is the charade signal in a down clue; 'spoiled' rearranges THISFOG into OFSIGHT.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase describes a straight unobstructed path from the eye to a target, which is a clear unbroken view.

clue.text: Recommend line in casual footwear products

indicators.note: the line and recommendation go inside the footwear word

parts.note: mules are backless slip-on shoes
to tip is to recommend, as in tipping a horse

explanation.surface: Advising a range of relaxed shoes as merchandise.
explanation.definitionFit: In arithmetic multiples of a number are the products of it with whole numbers; also chain stores.

clue.text: Egghead's underwear not yet unpacked?

definitions.note: 's stands for 'is', so the definition is just the brainy person

parts.note: a bra is an undergarment
something still in its box has not been unpacked

explanation.surface: A clever person's lingerie still sits in its packaging.
explanation.definitionFit: Both are informal words for a highly intellectual person, a swot or genius.

clue.text: Players collectively send for topless dress

parts.note: a band is a group of musicians

indicators.note: topless means the first letter is removed, here from the word for summoning

parts.note: to page someone is to summon them

explanation.surface: Musicians as a group call for a revealing outfit.
explanation.walkthrough: 'dress' is a verb here: to dress a wound is to bandage it.
explanation.definitionFit: Dressing a wound means binding it with a covering, the same as putting a bandage on.

clue.text: Record back-to-back articles at length

parts.note: the article an placed back-to-back with its own reversal gives an and na

explanation.surface: Documenting a pair of reverse-paired items at great length.
explanation.definitionFit: An annal is a yearly historical entry, a chronicle or written account.

clue.text: Present taken up

indicators.note: in a down entry, up means the word is read from bottom to top

parts.note: won is taken, as a prize or game is taken

explanation.surface: A gift has been picked up.
explanation.definitionFit: Present as a noun of time means the current moment, this very time.

clue.text: Even fouler pong rising over landscape shortly

indicators.note: in a down entry the reversed smell sits over the scenery
in a down entry rising means the smell word is read upwards

parts.note: BO, body odour, is a pong, British slang for a bad smell

indicators.note: shortly means the last letter is cut off

parts.note: scenery is landscape

explanation.surface: A worse stench drifting up across the countryside.
explanation.definitionFit: Obscene means grossly offensive or foul, so the comparative is more foul still.

clue.text: Tale-teller and diarist taking nothing back

indicators.note: the diarist takes on the extra letters after her name

parts.note: Anne Frank wrote the famous wartime diary

indicators.note: back means the word for nothing is reversed

parts.note: nil means nothing

explanation.surface: A storyteller and a journal writer returning empty-handed.
explanation.definitionFit: The Franklin is a pilgrim in Chaucer's Canterbury Tales who narrates one of the stories.

clue.text: Most fresh sources of lamb welcomed by conservationists

indicators.note: the sheep are welcomed inside the conservation body's letters

parts.note: NT is the National Trust, a British heritage conservation charity
ewes are mother sheep, which produce lambs

explanation.surface: The youngest lambs' mothers are taken in by heritage workers.
explanation.walkthrough: 'sources of lamb' looks like a first-letters signal, but it means the mother sheep.
explanation.definitionFit: The superlative of new, meaning the freshest or most recent.

clue.text: I see sweeper's action set back Italian football team

indicators.note: set back means the assembled pieces are reversed

parts.note: lo is an old word meaning see or behold
to pan is to sweep a camera across a scene

explanation.surface: Noticing a defender's move undone against an Italian side.
explanation.walkthrough: 'sweeper' suggests a football defender, but it is a camera's sweeping motion.
explanation.definitionFit: SSC Napoli is the Serie A club based in Naples, whose Italian name it carries.

clue.text: Building bird table without support ultimately, one improvises

indicators.note: building means the letters are constructed into a new shape
without means the chosen letter is dropped from bird table
ultimately points to the final letter of support

explanation.surface: Constructing a feeder for birds with no stand.
explanation.walkthrough: 'without support ultimately' removes T, the last letter of support, leaving BIRDABLE to rearrange.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who ad-libs speaks or performs spontaneously, without a script.

clue.text: Maintain western bias in play

indicators.note: letters in play are moving freely, so these words are rearranged

explanation.surface: Keep up a prejudice in favour of the West in a drama.
explanation.definitionFit: To bear witness is to testify or assert something as true, to declare or affirm it.

clue.text: Unruly devils later seizing power given valuable cover

indicators.note: the rearranged letters seize and hold the power letter
unruly means disorderly, so these words are mixed up

explanation.surface: Rowdy demons later grab control and get a precious coating.
explanation.definitionFit: Plated items are coated in a thin layer of a precious metal, a costly covering.

clue.text: Austere in speech, you are fronting appeal to stop hysteria

indicators.note: the inserted letters stop up the middle of the hysteria word

parts.note: panic is hysteria

indicators.note: the spoken letters come in front of the appeal word
in speech means the words are said aloud and spelt by sound

parts.note: the words you are, said out loud, sound like the two letters U and R, as in text-speak
it is sex appeal, as in the 'It girl'

explanation.surface: Speaking sternly, you're heading a plea to calm frenzy.
explanation.walkthrough: 'you are' said aloud sounds like the letters U R.
explanation.definitionFit: Puritans were known for strict, severe morals, so the adjective means stern and ascetic.

clue.text: Two leaders in sensational case calming down

indicators.note: the two leading letters of the word sensational are taken

parts.note: the dative is a grammatical case

explanation.surface: Two bosses in a juicy court trial cool off.
explanation.walkthrough: 'case' suggests a court trial, but it is a grammatical case. 'down' is a link word.
explanation.definitionFit: A sedative drug soothes and quietens, so it is soothing or tranquillising.

clue.text: Confines one tailless bird with another

parts.note: to hedge is to fence in or confine

indicators.note: tailless means the bird loses its last letter

parts.note: a parrot is a bird

explanation.surface: Something hems in a docked bird alongside a second.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition 'another' means another bird, following on from 'one ... bird'.
explanation.definitionFit: The dunnock, a small brown British songbird, is one more bird besides the parrot.

clue.text: A final appearance upset Greek maiden

indicators.note: in a down entry upset means the pieces are turned upside down

parts.note: a final is the end
an air is an appearance or manner

explanation.surface: One last showing on stage goes wrong.
explanation.definitionFit: In Greek myth she was the Cretan princess who gave Theseus the thread to escape the labyrinth.

clue.text: Part of ship in which sailors stored grain

indicators.note: the sailors are stored inside the ship part

parts.note: the keel is the ship's backbone
RN is the Royal Navy

explanation.surface: A section of a vessel where crew kept corn.
explanation.definitionFit: A kernel is a seed of a cereal such as wheat or maize.

clue.text: Deprived singers rejecting one floosie's account

indicators.note: rejecting means the assembled pieces are turned back to front

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral one
a tart is a floosie; with 's it gives tarts

explanation.surface: Choristers turn down a loose woman's story.
explanation.definitionFit: Castrati were male singers castrated young to keep a high voice, deprived of their manhood.

clue.text: Raise commotion about limits of debt

indicators.note: the commotion goes about, around, the picked letters

parts.note: ado is fuss or commotion

indicators.note: limits are the outer letters of debt

explanation.surface: Kicking up a fuss over the extent of what is owed.
explanation.definitionFit: To raise a sum is to increase it, the same as augmenting it.

clue.text: Like the Red Baron, flier showed the way

parts.note: a tit is a small bird, a flier
led is the past of lead, showed the way

explanation.surface: A First World War ace who flew in front.
explanation.definitionFit: Manfred von Richthofen was a German baron, so he held a noble rank.

clue.text: Watched United after contest

indicators.note: the united word comes after the contest word

parts.note: to vie is to contest or compete
wed means joined in marriage, united

explanation.surface: A sports fan saw Manchester United following a match.
explanation.walkthrough: 'United' suggests a football team, but it means married.
explanation.definitionFit: To view is to look at or observe, so the past form means looked at.

clue.text: Author spoken of one aspect of Tolstoy's epic

indicators.note: spoken of means the author's name is said aloud

parts.note: Evelyn Waugh was an English novelist

explanation.surface: A writer discusses a feature of a great Russian novel.
explanation.definitionFit: Tolstoy's epic is War and Peace, and fighting is one of its twin themes.

clue.text: Keeps filthy stuff one's concocted

parts.note: dung is animal muck

indicators.note: concocted means the letters of one's are mixed up

explanation.surface: Holding on to muck someone has whipped up.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Keeps' is a plural noun: castle strongholds.
explanation.definitionFit: A keep is a castle's central tower, and its underground cells are prisons in the stronghold.

clue.text: Formidable loud organ — remarkable!

parts.note: F is forte, the musical direction for loud
the ear is an organ of hearing
some is slang for remarkable, as in 'that was some party'

explanation.surface: A powerful pipe organ is truly impressive.
explanation.walkthrough: 'organ' suggests a musical instrument, but it is a body part.
explanation.definitionFit: Both describe something inspiring dread or awe through its power.

clue.text: When temperature drops, precious one's clothed warmly

indicators.note: the trimmed word clothes, wraps around, the one letter
drops means the temperature letter falls out

parts.note: precious means costly
one is I; 's is 'is', a link

explanation.surface: As it gets colder, a darling is bundled up snugly.
explanation.walkthrough: 'drops' removes T from COSTLY, leaving COSLY to wrap round I.
explanation.definitionFit: Snugly and comfortably, in a cosy manner, as by a fire.
